# FULL 365-DAY EXECUTION PLAN

# Day 1

## Phase
Foundation Architecture

## Primary Focus
project architecture

## Objective
Build and improve the project architecture subsystem with enterprise-grade architecture, scalability, operational realism, and future multiplayer compatibility.

---

## Detailed Tasks

### Planning
- Review previous day implementation
- Analyze technical debt
- Review performance metrics
- Review memory usage
- Review render metrics
- Define subsystem boundaries
- Define extensibility requirements
- Define future multiplayer impact

### Architecture
- Create scalable module structure
- Ensure ECS compatibility
- Ensure deterministic simulation compatibility
- Ensure worker-thread compatibility
- Ensure event-driven design
- Ensure modular separation
- Avoid tight coupling
- Review future AI integration points

### Implementation
- Build subsystem incrementally
- Add TypeScript strict typing
- Add reusable abstractions
- Add interfaces and schemas
- Add error handling
- Add logging hooks
- Add telemetry hooks
- Add performance instrumentation

### Rendering Validation
- Validate FPS stability
- Validate draw call count
- Validate memory allocation
- Validate object pooling
- Validate cleanup lifecycle
- Validate rendering scalability

### Simulation Validation
- Validate deterministic simulation
- Validate event propagation
- Validate state synchronization
- Validate worker synchronization
- Validate ECS consistency

### Testing
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Stress tests
- Edge case tests
- Multiplayer compatibility tests
- Regression tests

### Documentation
- Update architecture docs
- Update changelog
- Document subsystem decisions
- Document future improvements
- Document known limitations

---

## Deliverables
- Stable implementation for project architecture
- No TypeScript errors
- No memory leaks
- Passing tests
- Updated architecture docs

---

## Mandatory Verification

Run:
```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm run test
```

Performance Checks:
- FPS stable above 60
- No excessive rerenders
- No memory spikes
- No worker desync
- No rendering artifacts
